en.headline: Police raid village-house etomidate workshop in Lok Ma Chau
en.dek: Border District officers say they seized 5,960 suspected liquid etomidate cartridges worth more than HK$1.5 million and arrested a 40-year-old man.
body: Police said Border District crime officers raided a subdivided village house in Liu Pok Tsuen, Lok Ma Chau, on Monday evening and shut down what they described as an etomidate manufacturing workshop and store.

Officers arrested a 40-year-old local man on suspicion of trafficking in and manufacturing a dangerous drug. Police said they seized 5,960 suspected liquid etomidate vape cartridges and a quantity of raw materials and tools, with an estimated market value of more than HK$1.5 million.

Inspector Chan Chi-keung of the Border District anti-triad section said officers had been watching the unit and stopped the man at about 6.40pm as he left carrying a bag. Police said the bag held 18 parcels containing 2,050 cartridges, with a further 20 found in a light goods vehicle and 3,890 inside the unit, along with flavouring oil, a hotplate, syringes and empty cartridge shells.

Police said they believed the workshop had been operating since early this year and that the man had been paid about HK$30,000 to HK$40,000 a month to refine, pack and deliver the drug for local supply. He has not been convicted of the alleged offences.

zh.headline: 警搗落馬洲村屋依托咪酯工場 檢近六千煙彈
zh.dek: 邊界警區周一晚搜查落馬洲料壘村分租單位，檢獲5,960粒懷疑液態依托咪酯煙彈，市值逾150萬元，並拘捕一名40歲男子。
body: 警方表示，邊界警區刑事部周一晚上突擊搜查落馬洲料壘村一個村屋分租單位，搗破一個依托咪酯製毒工場及毒品儲存倉。
行動中，一名40歲本地男子涉嫌販運及製造危險藥物被捕。警方稱檢獲5,960粒懷疑液態依托咪酯煙彈，以及一批原材料和工具，估計市值超過150萬元。
邊界警區反三合會行動組督察陳志強表示，探員埋伏後，約晚上6時40分截停一名提袋步出單位的男子。警方指袋內有18個包裹，藏2,050粒煙彈，其輕型貨車再檢20粒，單位內再檢3,890粒，另有香味甘油、電磁爐、針筒及大量煙彈膠殼。
警方相信工場由今年年初起運作，該名男子報稱無業，涉嫌每月收取約3萬至4萬元，負責提煉、包裝及運送毒品供應本地市場。他尚未被定罪。
